dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: These buildings and those spherical lamps — they use this style in Merusea Village, don't they? I recognize them from a picture album.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Legends say that the home of the Melusines is a secluded little village deep under the water, far away from the rest of the world — the kind of village you read about in fairytales. But I've always believed it's real.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Um... But please don't tell anyone else I said that. Most people would probably think I'm just being childish...
